title: 慢一點也可以
subject: a slow Sunday morning
caption: Neo-soul in Mandarin. A stripped trio — Rhodes electric piano playing extended jazz voicings, brushed drums, upright double bass walking loosely — with a muted trumpet answering in the second verse. A husky female lead sings conversationally, runs melismas at the ends of lines, and opens from a whisper into a full belt on the last chorus. Warm analog saturation, plate reverb, close-miked and unhurried. 88 BPM, B-flat major. Warm, generous, domestic.
lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
咖啡在爐上自己滾著
我沒有急著關火
你還在睡 翻了個身
把整條被子捲走

[Pre-Chorus]
今天沒有要去的地方

[Chorus]
慢一點也可以
世界不會因為我們遲到就塌
你睡到幾點都行
我把太陽留在窗簾外面等

[Verse 2]
樓下有人在修腳踏車
鄰居的貓又跳上圍牆
這些聲音我以前嫌吵
現在覺得剛剛好

[Trumpet Solo]

[Chorus]
慢一點也可以
世界不會因為我們遲到就塌
你睡到幾點都行
我把太陽留在窗簾外面等

[Outro]
再睡一下
再睡一下
